content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian nationals possessing the requisite educational qualifications and relevant experience can apply for these positions. Candidates must refer to the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.post: Project Fellow (for Development of CFD guidelines)
rows.qualification_required: Ph.D. in Mechanical/Civil/Hydropower Engineering or relevant discipline having CFD/design-based work in hydro turbine/ PumpOrM Tech in Mechanical/Civil/Hydropower Engineering or relevant discipline with 3-year experience in CFD/ design of hydro turbine / pump

rows.post: Project Fellow (screw low head turbine / other low head turbine)
rows.qualification_required: Ph.D. Or M. Tech. in Mechanical/Hydropower/Aeronautical / Civil Engineering or relevant discipline having Design including solid work and CFD based work of hydraulic turbine / rotating machine / aerodynamics

rows.post: Project Fellow / Research Associate (for Potential Assessment)
rows.qualification_required: Ph.D. Or M. Tech. in Mechanical/Hydropower/Civil Engineering or relevant discipline having experience in potential assessment of renewable energy resources

rows.post: Research Associate (for mechanical design of model and prototype turbine)
rows.qualification_required: M Tech in Mechanical Engineering or relevant discipline with experience in composite manufacturing and testing of hydro kinetic turbine

content_sections.text: The engagement for all positions is for a duration of 1 year or up to the project completion date. Selected candidates are entitled to monthly emoluments along with House Rent Allowance (HRA) as per project provisions:

content_sections.heading: IIT Roorkee Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The duties and responsibilities assigned for the project positions include the following: Preliminary assessment based on the secondary data available from government sites and reports, visits to potential sites of ultra low head and hydrokinetic energy, coordination and compilation with agencies having the details of canals, rivers, outfall structure and dam toe. Setting up of laboratory & design of hydro kinetic turbine, CFD simulation & carry out design, model test and fabrication of proto type hydro kinetic turbine, analyzing the data, report preparation. Carry out CFD simulation of Francis/ reversible pump turbines for development of standard procedure and guidelines and model testing, scientific report writing. Carry out laboratory and field test regarding Ultra low head and screw turbine. Design and field testing of hydro kinetic turbine, perform CFD simulation (pre and post processing) for designed turbines. FEM analysis of turbine component for varying hydrodynamics loads. Model and field testing of ULH turbine, analyzing the data, report preparation. Define the standard procedure and guidelines for CFD analysis and model testing of turbine.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Roorkee Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates desiring to apply for the positions should follow the official submission process outlined below: Prepare an application on plain paper containing a detailed CV including chronological discipline of degree/certificates obtained. Compile documentation of experience including research, industrial field and others. Attach attested copies of degree/certificate and experience certificate. Submit the complete application packet along with enclosures to the office of the Principal Investigator through email, by post or produce at the time of Interview. Ensure the application is submitted to the office of the Principal Investigator on or before Nov 02, 2026 by 5 PM.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: The following documents must be submitted with the application and produced at the interview: Application in a plain paper with detailed CV including chronological discipline of degree/certificates obtained. Experience including research, industrial field and others. Attested copies of degree/certificate and experience certificate. Original degree(s)/certificate(s) and experience certificate(s) at the time of interview for verification.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates before appearing for the interview shall ensure that they are eligible for the position they intend to apply. No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview. Preference will be given to SC/ST candidates on equal qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available under IIT Roorkee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 project positions available (1 Project Fellow for CFD guidelines, 1 Project Fellow for screw low head turbine / other low head turbine, 1 Project Fellow / Research Associate for Potential Assessment, and 1 Research Associate for mechanical design of model and prototype turbine).
